title: The Ghost of Vienna
author: Marguerite Thackeray
blurb: Silas Fairweather, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
